about_the_game:
No Way Back: Dark Horizon throws you into a desperate fight for survival on an isolated island used for human experiments. After a plane crash, you wake up on an unknown shore. Soon you realize the island is infested with zombies—once humans, now twisted results of a failed scientific experiment.

Key Features

• Survival Gameplay: Manage your hunger and stamina while using resources wisely.

• Action-Packed Combat: Face relentless zombies and choose the right weapons and tactics to survive.

• Exploration & Mystery: Discover hidden laboratories, abandoned camps, and uncover the dark history of the island.

• Base Building & Crafting: Gather materials, create tools, and build your own safe zone.

• Unfolding Story: Collect clues about the island’s past, reveal the truth behind the experiments, and search for a way to escape.

Gameplay

The island is a constantly shifting and dangerous environment:

• Use the daytime to explore and scavenge for supplies.

• Prepare for the night when zombies become more aggressive and survival becomes even harder.

Every day brings new challenges, dangers, and opportunities. Surviving won’t be easy, but each step uncovers more of the island’s mystery and brings you closer to escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.8 Ghz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD 500 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.2 Ghz Quad Core CPU or faster
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
